This template is to be used for all [https://www.skyound.com skysound.com] webpages.

==Usage==
Copy the template code below, and paste it into an article's reference note. Fill in as many parameters as you can, remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{SkySound|url=|text=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} URL of the web page, minus the domain name (<code><nowiki>https://www.skysound.com/</nowiki></code>).
*{{Para|text}} Name of the page being cited.

{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Examples==
<code><nowiki>{{SkySound|url=latest/behind-the-sound-of-mandalorian-and-obi-wan-kenobi|text=Behind The Sound of The Mandalorian and Obi-Wan Kenobi}}</nowiki></code>

*{{SkySound|url=latest/behind-the-sound-of-mandalorian-and-obi-wan-kenobi|text=Behind The Sound of The Mandalorian and Obi-Wan Kenobi}}
